Hezbollah said its fighters targeted Israeli troops 'massed in the border towns of Naqura and Qawzah' and across other border sites with more than 100 rockets. The US announced a temporary 30-day lifting of sanctions on the sale and delivery of Iranian oil already loaded onto tankers by March 20, which must be unloaded by April 19. Senior Houthi Official Signals Naval Blockade and Red Sea Attacks Imminent.
